hooks.command:
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -q 'articles/.*\.html$'; then RESULT=$(bash scripts/lint.sh "$f" 2>&1); ERRORS=$(echo "$RESULT" | grep -c '^ERROR' || true); WARNINGS=$(echo "$RESULT" | grep -c '^WARNING' || true); SUMMARY=$(echo "$RESULT" | tail -3); if [ "$ERRORS" -gt 0 ]; then ERROR_LINES=$(echo "$RESULT" | grep '^ERROR'); printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"lint.sh ERROR %s件検出。修正してください。","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"lint.sh ERROR検出:
%s

サマリー:
%s"}}' "$ERRORS" "$ERROR_LINES" "$SUMMARY"; else printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"lint.sh結果: ERROR 0件 / WARNING %s件 → パス"}}' "$WARNINGS"; fi; else echo '{}'; fi; }
hooks.statusMessage: lint.sh で記事チェック中...
